limitations: Inverse validation of Hagan asymptotic IV map only; exact SABR general pricing, dynamics, model error and arbitrage freedom are not validated.
SLSQP and TRF convergence is local. Ten independent optimizer checks do not establish every global profile minimum or global uniqueness.

Step differences estimate numerical uncertainty; 12/270 unrestricted fits were unresolved, all weak/ATM. Best fits for weak/ATM reps 1 and 2 remain unresolved despite finite numerical condition values.
Five noiseless weak/ATM starts stopped at nfev=400 and are retained as failed finite attempts. No stopping budget was expanded.
Chi-square threshold is a descriptive pointwise reference. Boundary/nonidentified likelihood-ratio laws and nominal 95% coverage remain unverified.
Main original denominator is retained with included/excluded/unknown. Known-only Wilson summaries and finite visited holdout price ranges do not certify confidence coverage or joint envelopes.
Review-time backend captured NumPy/SciPy OpenBLAS with one actual thread each; original pilot directly recorded thread environment/version, not runtime threadpool metadata.
Original runtime serialization_pending flag precedes final save; separate bound serialization receipt supplies the measured completed save cost.
Earlier failed/old-source pilots were not pooled or promoted; only current pilot record and typed arrays are approved.
